title: Login dialog not activated after starting mRemoteNG
author: jdschuitemaker
body_snippet:
For security reasons we enabled login for mRemoteNG. When you start the application and the login dialog shows you first need to activate it. It would be nice if that dialog is active after it opens/shows so you can start typing right away without having to make it the active window first.

We are on version 1.78.2 (Nightly Build 3405) x64.
